newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: Kleinwort Benson ups 1997/98 Nestle EPS.
newsitem.headline: Kleinwort Benson ups 1997/98 Nestle EPS.

text.p: Kleinwort Benson said it had raised earnings estimates for food giant Nestle AG for 1997 and 1998 based on depreciation in the Swiss franc.

Kleinwort Benson, which already had Nestle as a "buy" based on the food group's new management team, said a further boost in profit estimates was possible if the Swiss franc falls significantly farther against major currencies.
Kleinwort Benson said it now expected Nestle earnings per share (EPS) of 94.4 Swiss francs, up seven percent from an earlier estimate of 88.2.
